Chapter 128

Outside Changchun City, ten miles to the east, sits in the middle of a hill.

The winding path stretches all the way up the mountain. Countless pebbles and jade are used on the path, and some green boards are used to pave a quiet path.

Originally, there was no such a simple but exquisite path here, but because he had a distinguished guest who came to this hill today, he had it.

Thousands of exquisite craftsmen, with decades of exquisite craftsmanship, were driven here by batches of officials because of a whim of one person. With the fastest speed, the most ingenious skills, and the most fantastic design, this path was paved in just three days.

At this moment, there are guards at every three steps, and guards at every five steps along the path. The naked eyes on both sides of the road can't see anywhere, and there are countless hidden eyes, carefully watching every move around.

At the intersection of the small road, I saw a group of people dressed in gorgeous and majestic official robes, surrounded by a man, and walked slowly towards the mountain together with a large group of attendants.

Stepping on a brand new slate, there are some pebbles around the slate, and a layer of fine sand is spread among the pebbles. At this moment, all things should be reborn, when the spring is warm and the flowers are blooming, but on this path, after artificial treatment, there is no trace of green.

"Ju Shou, are you the Secretary of the Household Department? Let me ask you, now that the Jizi North Korean region captured by General Cao has started to count the household registration again and enter the register by household!" Think about the current situation in your mind.

"Your Majesty, there are thirteen cities in the southeast of your area captured by General Cao. Three of these cities are still on the front line and are close to the capital of Jizi North Korea. They are in danger of enemy attacks at any time, so they have not yet been registered. Included." Ju Shou was a little ashamed.

"Oh, there are three cities that have not been counted, so does that mean that ten cities have been counted?" He didn't care about these details. In a hurry, there were some problems that were difficult to deal with. It was reasonable to grasp the things that could be done, and asked targeted questions.

"Your Majesty, the remaining ten cities, Wei Chen and the Minister of the Ministry of Officials, Xun Yu, have organized officials to go to various places to carry out the most basic governance, and some results have been obtained from the household registration statistics. At this time, there are more than 24,000 households in the ten cities. There are more than 131,000 people. Among them, there are 53,000 males, which is a rich and fertile land!" Speaking of this, Ju Shou's face was a little excited, obviously, he was also somewhat unexpected about the wealth and population of Jizi North Korea of.

"Oh, there is such a large population. It seems that this country has been in peace for a long time, and it has multiplied so many people. Based on this estimate, the population of this country is almost 500,000 to 600,000, which is equivalent to the smallest among the Seven Heroes. Half of the population of South Korea!" At this time, after losing the land of Shangdang Changping, South Korea's land area has shrunk greatly, and its population has also dropped to less than 1 million. Calling him a hero is somewhat inaccurate.

"Exactly, if our country can take down this place,

The public can expand him by at least 500,000, and the land can expand thousands of miles. If it can go further down, wipe out those barbarians in the south, and occupy the entire Korean peninsula. He can get another two to three hundred thousand people, so compared to those powerful countries in the Central Plains, he is second only to Qin Chu. "Xun Yu also said with a little excitement, obviously these plans were planned in his heart, not just for a while.

"That's right. With this area of the peninsula, there are enough to support 2 million people. But now, the total number of residents on the whole island is only 800,000. It's really a waste. After taking this island, when 700,000 immigrants, In order to enrich the peninsula, we can use those immigrants as the foundation of our rule, and slowly assimilate the natives of the peninsula. After three to five years, our imperial kingdom’s rule here will be deeply rooted and not so easy to shake!” Speaking of this , Zhong Yu was still a little depressed.

Before that, he directly transferred 3 million civilians from the Three Kingdoms, and originally wanted to fill them into the main world. But who would have thought that the Heavenly Dao of the world would notice that he was an intruder and wanted to come for disinfection, such a thing.

Completely breaking his original plan, he had to place those civilians in his own system space.

But to put them in the system space, it is secondary whether they take up space or not. The most important thing is that if they don't stay in it for a moment, they need to pay a lot of luck points to maintain the necessary basis for their existence.

One or two days is nothing to me, it's just a drizzle, but the problem is that if you calculate it for more than ten days and a few months, it will be a big expense.

Now in the current Jizhou, he has resettled his millions of immigrants, plus some local grassland natives, and the population of the entire state is 1.23 million. It is enough to maintain the most basic rule and development.

But in the system space, there are still 2 million civilians left, and I don't know how to arrange them. In order to reduce the consumption of luck points, Cao Cao had to go to conquer Jizi North Korea, whose depth was still unknown, when he had no choice but to gain a foothold.

Just want to win some more land, so that they can be used to resettle these 2 million civilians. Cao Cao is now going to fight in the southeast of Jizi North Korea, the peninsula where it is located.

And I will send troops again at the end of this month, taking advantage of the unprepared timing of those Donghu tribes. Catch them off guard, try to knock them down together, and drive them out of the Northeast Plain. Even directly destroy them and annex all their territory and population.

All of this is for the sake of survival, and he has 3 million people brought out from the Three Kingdoms under his command to be resettled. As their king, I should consider them first and give them a place enough for them to survive.

Let them have enough land to cultivate and a warm house to live in. In this way, they will love themselves and be desperate for an order of their own.

"Tian Feng, how is the mobilization of your troops and horses going? In ten days' time, it will be the moment when our army goes out for an expedition. Are all the food, grass, supplies, and logistics supplies appropriate? Are there any mistakes or difficulties? Department, you can say it now, and I will try my best to satisfy your request!"

As far as the southeast peninsula is concerned, now that the general situation has been understood and the basic situation is confirmed, there should not be any major changes. After deciding on a rough goal, Zhong Yu was left behind. Instead, he asked about the upcoming war between Yuguo and the Donghu people.

"The mobilization work has been prepared. In addition to the 50,000 Imperial Forest Army in His Majesty's hand, there are also 50,000 elite veterans who will follow the expedition. As for materials, there are reserves in the Three Kingdoms World, but they are still very sufficient. The entire Northeast, and resettlement of millions of civilians, is enough. It’s just that if we go down to fight with Yan, then there will be a shortage of supplies!” At the end, Tian Feng was a little worried about Zhong Zhong Said.

"Don't worry about this. I just need to fight the Donghu people, and there will be no shortage of supplies. As for the contact with the Yan people in the south, it is not yet time. At least three years later, all the territories occupied by our imperial country are basically stable. , will start to think about it." First appease Tian Feng, and signal him not to be too entangled.

"Before that, all the tasks were to conquer all the barbarians, accumulate enough strength as much as possible, and then go south in one fell swoop, so that the seven heroes of the Warring States can also experience and fear the power of our imperial kingdom!"

After finishing speaking, he had already walked to the highest point of the mountain, and entered a delicate small gazebo for people to rest. With his hands on his back, he looked south, with a firm face and extremely deep eyes.
